_comment: Example operator policy for tools/autonomy-controller. Copy it OUTSIDE every checkout (for example /etc/ashlar/controller-policy.json, mode 0600) and point the controller at it with --policy or ASHLAR_CONTROLLER_POLICY. The loader refuses a policy that lives inside a checkout, so this file cannot be the active policy. Model ids: claude-sonnet-5 is recognised by the installed Claude Code CLI (2.1.263, probed 2026-10-11); whether the API accepts it on this account is unverified until the first live launch. Codex (PR 5): gpt-6-astra was accepted by codex-cli 0.162.0-alpha.17.2 on a ChatGPT login (probed 2026-10-12); the earlier candidate sol was refused with HTTP 400 "not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account". Cursor (PR 5): composer-standard is unverified, because the Cursor agent CLI was not logged in when probed. Both stay disabled until the operator enables them.
